message: The brainstorm gate revised a clarify-gate answer. Clarify put FR-9 gutter content in the Notes tab; brainstorm found FR-28 already fills that tab with AnnotationRows, so every annotation would render twice and leader lines would cross composables. Revised to an in-stage right-edge gutter. Recording it as a REVISION rather than letting the two artifacts silently disagree - clarify.json survey[] still carries the superseded answer, and Stage 5 must read brainstorm as the later decision. Also recorded: AC-5 and AC-7 carry verificationMethod=test from the PRD, but this repo has zero Compose UI tests among 160 green, so they will be satisfied by pure plus reducer tests plus a preview rather than by the rendered assertion the method implies. That is a verification-method mismatch inherited from upstream, not a shortcut taken here.

SECOND occurrence: the refine agent reported writing proposedSurvey into data.survey but the payload shipped with zero entries, so the gate decisions existed only in its message. Same defect on F-2, where I caught it the same way and patched manually. It is a real pattern worth fixing in the agent definition rather than in each run - the orchestrator should keep verifying survey length after every refine wrap. Carried to the batched retrospective.
